name: @useyolo/source-ytdlp
description: Official Yolo source plugin: web video URLs and playlists resolved with yt-dlp

summary.en: Plays links to videos on the web that you or your agent hand Yolo.
summary.zh: 播放你或你的 agent 交给 Yolo 的网页视频链接。

help.en: A Netscape cookie file on the home machine, for sites you are signed in to
help.zh: 家里电脑上的 Netscape cookie 文件，用于你登录过的网站

help.en: A browser on the home machine, such as chrome or firefox
help.zh: 家里电脑上的浏览器，例如 chrome 或 firefox

privacy.en: Sends the links you play to their sites, from the home machine. Keeps nothing but caches.
privacy.zh: 从家里的电脑把你播放的链接发给对应的网站。除缓存外不保存任何东西。
